name: torlink-desktop
description: 中文优先的开源 BitTorrent 搜索与下载桌面客户端

scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @torlink/protocol && npm run build --workspace @torlink/i18n
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @torlink/desktop
scripts.tauri: npm run build:shared && npm run tauri --workspace @torlink/desktop --
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @torlink/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @torlink/i18n && npm run typecheck --workspace @torlink/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @torlink/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @torlink/protocol && npm run test --workspace @torlink/i18n && npm run test --workspace @torlink/core && npm run test --workspace @torlink/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @torlink/protocol && npm run build --workspace @torlink/i18n && npm run build --workspace @torlink/core && npm run build --workspace @torlink/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:rust
